messages:
Lina: Heads-up: SXSW booth in Austin in two weeks. Need final staffing rota, demo schedule, and a short press blurb for on-site media. Also swag shortage: vendor says thin-stock on lanyards.
Omar: I can do staffing + demo schedule. Proposal: 3 shifts/day (morning/afternoon/evening) with 2 reps each. Morning slot should include a 12:15 demo run (10m) to catch lunchtime traffic.
Priya: I'll own the press blurb and speaker follow-up. Draft is a 2-sentence opener + 1 line about our benchmark claim and link to signup. I'll post copy later today.
Ben: Swag update: vendor low on lanyards; offered upgrade to branded notebooks at small premium. ETA shipment Fri 9am. Do we accept? Budget impact ~ $150.
Lina: Accept notebooks instead of lanyards — better perceived value. Approving $150. @ben please confirm final SKU list.
Ben: Confirmed: 300 notebooks, 500 stickers, 100 stress-balls. Invoice: https://orders.vendor/INV-9876
Omar: Routing leads: switch from clipboard to QR-driven form (short form: name, email, company, interest: demo/benchmarks/webinar). Flow: QR -> Airtable -> HubSpot via Integromat. Tag: source=sxsw2026, cohort=conference. Auto-email: immediate thank-you + webinar invite scheduled for 7 days after.
Lina: Add fallback: we still carry paper cards in case phones are slow. Someone should scan cards nightly and upload to Airtable.
Omar: Agreed. Staffing note: Ben + Lina on Day1 morning. Omar + Priya Day1 afternoon. Day2 rotate. I'll paste the shift table here by EOD.
Priya: Speaker submissions: we were accepted for a 20-min stage slot at 3pm on Day2. Need final slide deck and one-line speaker bios. Also coordinate with event producer for AV check at 2pm.
Lina: AV check confirmed? @ops-bot can you ping events ops for the AV contact and confirm mic type?
ops-bot: Reminder: submit AV rider by 72hrs pre-event. Event contact: avery@events.com. Recommended mic: lavalier + handheld. See: https://ops.redwood/av-guidelines
Priya: I'll submit slide deck tomorrow. Note: bench numbers in the deck reference internal beta tests. Legal flagged public claims; please avoid exact p95 latency numbers until sign-off. Use relative phrasing like "sub-100ms on typical TGI workloads" pending legal.
Lina: Good catch. We'll use conservative phrasing on the on-site screen. Priya, when you post draft, tag legal and me.
Ben: Demo flow: 1) quick 60s hook, 2) 3-min live demo showing low-latency generation + routing rules, 3) CTA -> sign up to webinar on QR. We should prerecord a fallback demo video in case WiFi is flaky. Who can record?
Omar: I can record the fallback. Need script and a clean laptop with patched model. I'll coordinate with infra to get a local model image.
Lina: Also bring portable hotspot + travel router. Ben, add to packing list: hotspot, HDMI adapter, short HDMI cable, power strip.
Ben: Added. Current packing: booth banners (2), iPad for QR scans (3), demo laptop, backup laptop, hotspot, chargers (4x), notebooks, stickers, business cards (250).
Priya: Follow-up cadence: immediate thank-you email (with webinar link), 3-day case study (benchmarks talk), 10-day SDR outreach. Omar owns upload to HubSpot; Priya will draft emails.
Omar: HubSpot mapping below (will be used in Integromat):
````
field mapping:
- full_name -> Contact.FullName
- email -> Contact.Email
- company -> Company.Name
- interest -> Contact.Property(Interest)
- source -> Contact.Property(Source) = sxsw2026
````
Filter: email present AND consent = true
Lina: One more: media kit for on-site press. Priya, can you include a one-paragraph company overview + three bullet product highlights and a hi-res logo package link?
Priya: Yes — will attach a Google Drive link in-thread once ready.
ops-bot: Logistics alert: booth proof must be uploaded 48hrs before the printer cutoff (https://ops.redwood/print-deadlines). Shipping window: arrive Thu 8am-12pm.
Lina: Meeting to confirm final checklist tomorrow 9:30am. Please post any blockers here before then.
